Account snapshot and sticky points:
- Company: mid-tier financial/wealth platform; heavy regulatory needs (EU + US client data).
- Workload: real-time chat assistant for advisors (primary), nightly reranking/embeddings batch jobs (secondary). Expectation: p95 end-to-end gen latency <120ms for 1k concurrent users, sustained throughput target ~300k tokens/min across dedicated pool.
- POC: SE proposed Dedicated capacity = reserved 4x A100-80GB equiv to hit throughput with 2x burst nodes for scheduled spikes. Running 72h perf run week of 2026-03-10.

Procurement/legal pushing back: want SLA credit cap tied to MSA liability cap — client wants separate SLA schedule that survives DPA redlines.
- Procurement blockers: DPA redlines around EU data residency (they insist certain EU subsets must stay in-region), insurance schedule — they need $10M cyber liability listed as insured risk for vendors, plus eCrime rider. This is delaying signature and therefore Reserved GPU provisioning timeline.
- Security: require SSO/SAML + audit_logging forwarded to SIEM; require KMS integration proof and evidence of encryption at rest; asked for SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 artifacts (we provided links in drive doc).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to annual reserved spend if SLA and compliance language firmed up. Estimated ARR band provided to procurement team.
- Quote/Docs: pricing deck + security FAQ shared (drive links above).
- Quote from Head of ML in call: "We need deterministic latency — if you can't guarantee p95, we'll split traffic to a cheaper hosted fallback but that undermines our compliance posture."
- Legal: redlines are specific — remove exculpatory language around compliance add-ons, clarify uptime vs latency terms. Procurement has paused budget release until redlines resolved.
- Internal ask: need Redwood legal + finance to provide: 1) MSA/DPA counterproposal with explicit SLA appendix, 2) endorsed insurance schedule template, 3) KMS integration diagram and SOC2 artifact bundle.
- Risk: if redlines not resolved by 2026-04 procurement cycle, they will evaluate alternate providers (Anthropic, Bedrock) with faster legal turnaround.
- AE notes: keep cadence weekly; cherrypick security items for quick 2-week win (SOC2 doc + KMS arch) while legal works through DPA.
